comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
This only impacts weapons that you buy from vanilla traders and find in raid.

SPT will still remember your previous FireMode selection on raid exit and set it accordingly on the weapon.

Same with AI in raid, if they switch to Single Fire, it will be Single Fire until it’s changed in raid.

If your weapons have lost the ability to full auto or burst fire, that isn’t being caused by this mod.

comments.body_html: Hi, I’m new to SPT but this mod doesn’t seem to be working for me. I saw the comment below that it “This only impacts weapons that you buy from vanilla traders and find in raid.” but I purchased an AKS-74U and it was on single fire at the beginning of the raid when I loaded in.

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
If the weapon was sold by being configured single fire, it’ll still be that way by default.

All this mod does is reorganize the defaults, so any weapon that doesn’t have it defined will be automatic.

Most trader listers don’t define the fire rate, most mod traders on the other hand do.

comments.body_html: Sorry, I’m still a bit confused. So this only works for weapons bought from traders added from mods? What’s the point if it only makes the weapons automatic from those traders instead of vanilla ones if that’s the case?

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
It depends on how the trader is coded for the assort. I haven’t reviewed the assort for vanilla since 3.9 as it’s a ton of data.

You don’t need to use the mod if you don’t think it has a point though. It does do what it’s intended to do, but you may not notice it until you go to loot a fresh weapon from a weapon box and go to use it.
